 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Orlando City SC host FC Cincinnati on Thursday, November 19, in Major League Soccer. Kickoff is set for 9:30 PM (Brasília time), with the venue still to be confirmed.
 Both teams arrive level on points. Orlando City SC sit eighth in the Eastern Conference with 46 points, while FC Cincinnati are ninth with the same tally.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Predictions and Odds
 The projected outcome is a draw, with an exact score of 1-1 favored. The model also leans toward under 2.5 goals and both teams to score — though confidence in the prediction is rated low.
 Odds have Orlando City SC to win at 2.4, a draw at 4.1, and FC Cincinnati to win at 2.45.
 Probable Lineups
 Orlando City SC: M. Crepeau, Vinicius Nogueira, Iago Teodoro, D. Brekalo, Z. Taifi, Ivan Angulo, E. Atuesta, Luis Otavio, Justin Ellis, A. Griezmann, Martin Ojeda. W. Cartagena and Braian Ojeda are doubtful, while R. Jansson and T. Spicer are out.
 FC Cincinnati: R. Celentano, N. Hagglund, M. Robinson, Samuel Gidi, Pavel Bucha, O. Nwobodo, B. Ramirez, D. Doudera, Evander, Tom Barlow, Kevin Denkey. T. Hadebe, T. Malacia, and J. Malatini are all doubtful.
